race.comment: SHALHAVMUSIK (12) is the one to beat after consecutive wins at Gawler and Murray Bridge, the latest a one-length BM58 success where she finished powerfully after being well found in betting. The rise to BM68 is the query, but she drops to 54kg and has already built a solid record at this distance. On top. TYUSIX (5) brings stronger grade references, having been fifth in a BM80 at Morphettville after early and home-turn interference and only just missed in Open grade the run prior. Key runner. WIND RUSH (10) beat BAYOU MUSIC by just under four lengths in a metro Class 2 last start and comes here on the quick back-up with Todd Pannell staying aboard. BAYOU MUSIC (8) has the inside draw, first-time blinkers and a strong wet-track profile, but must bridge a clear margin on WIND RUSH from their recent meeting.
